basicAttack.name: Half Truths
basicAttack.descriptionEvidence: Basic Attack Aalto fires up to 5 consecutive shots, dealing Aero DMG. Basic Attack 4 will spread the "Mist" forward, which lasts for 1.5s. Heavy Attack Aalto enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot. The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals Aero DMG. Mid-air Attack Aalto consumes Stamina to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing Aero DMG. Dodge Counter Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

Mist Drops Aalto can hold up to 6 Mist Drops. When Basic Attack or Mid-air Attack passes through "Mist" and hits the target, 1 "Mist Drop" is recovered.

outroSkill.descriptionEvidence: The next character (or other characters on a nearby team that activates an Outro Skill) gains 23% Aero DMG Deepen for 14 seconds or until the Character is switched.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 1
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The cooldown of Resonance Skill Shift Trick is reduced by 4s.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 2
sequences.descriptionEvidence: "Mist Avatar" inherits 100% more HP from Aalto. When Aalto attacks targets taunted by the "Mist Avatar(s)", his ATK is increased by 15%.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 3
sequences.descriptionEvidence: When Aalto's Basic Attack or Mid-Air Attack passes through the "Gate of Quandary", 2 more bullets will be generated, dealing 50% of the DMG of Basic Attack or Mid-Air Attack.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 4
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The damage of Resonance Skill Mist Bullets is increased by 30%; Aalto receives 30% less damage in his Forte Circuit Mistcloak Dash state.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 5
sequences.descriptionEvidence: In the Forte Circuit Mistcloak Dash state, Aalto's Aero DMG Bonus is increased by 25% for 6s.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 6
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Resonance Liberation Flower in the Mist now additionally increases Crit. Rate by 8%. When Aalto's Heavy Attack passes through the "Gate of Quandary", the damage dealt is additionally increased by 50%.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 1
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Casting Resonance Skill recovers 1 point of Trance. The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Graceful Step, Resonance Skill Flickering Reverie, and Forte Circuit Perception Drain is increased by 50%. Immune to interruptions while casting Perception Drain.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 2
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation now sends the target into Hazy Dream. The DMG Multiplier of Jolt triggered by Cantarella is increased by 245%.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 3
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation is increased by 370%. After casting Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation, enter into Mirage. If already in Mirage, casting Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation does not activate the Mirage state again.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 4
sequences.descriptionEvidence: When in Mirage, Healing Bonus is increased by 25%.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 5
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The maximum number of Dreamweavers Cantarella can summon through Resonance Liberation Diffusion is increased by 5.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 6
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Increase the DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack Phantom Sting by 80%. Casting Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation makes Cantarella's DMG ignore 30% of the target's DEF for 10s. For the first 1.2s of Hazy Dream, when the target takes an instance of DMG that does not inflict Hazy Dream, Jolt will not be triggered on the target.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 1
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Chisa is immune to interruption during Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter Inflicting Unseen Snare grants the following additional effects: Chisa's ATK is increased by 30% for 15s. Deal fixed 61803 points of Havoc DMG. The target's HP can be reduced to 61.80% at most and each target can take this damage only once. This instance of damage is considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from damage bonuses.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 2
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Ignore 10% of the target's Havoc RES when dealing damage. Nearby Resonators in the team with Thread of Bane gain 50% All-Attribute DMG Bonus.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 3
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The DMG Multipliers of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter and Sawring - Eradication are increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of Woven Myriad - Convergence. The bonus DMG Multiplier for Sawring - Eradication granted by Sawring- Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter when Ring of Chainsaw is consumed is increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of Woven Myriad - Convergence. The Vibration Strength Reduction Rate of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter and Sawring - Eradication is increased by 50%.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 4
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The effect of Unseen Snare becomes: When targets marked by Unseen Snare take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 stack of Havoc Bane on them. This effect is triggered up to once every 1s.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 5
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility gains 100% DMG Bonus. Lifethread - Glide costs 50% less Lifethread - Jetstream.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 6
sequences.descriptionEvidence: When Chisa takes a fatal blow during Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, she will remain standing with at least 1 HP. Unseen Snare becomes Unseen Snare - Finality, which has the following effects: Unseen Snare - Finality has all the effects of Unseen Snare. Targets affected by Unseen Snare - Finality takes 30% Amplified DMG from Negative Statuses. Targets affected by Unseen Snare - Finality takes 40% increased DMG from Chisa.

basicAttack.name: POW POW
basicAttack.descriptionEvidence: Basic Attack Chixia fires up to 4 consecutive shots at a single target, dealing Fusion DMG. Heavy Attack Chixia enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot. The shot fired deals Fusion DMG. Mid-air Attack Chixia consumes Stamina to continuously shoot the target in the air, dealing Fusion DMG. Dodge Counter Use a Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

sequences.name: Yin and Yang in Harmony, the Ultimate Law of Being

Upon entering combat, Jingran gains the following effects, triggered once every 4s: Gains 300 points of Qi. Gains Netherworld's Boon. sequences.name: World's Course Shifts, Each to Their Rightful Paths

Yin-Yang Everflow Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Jingran's Max HP, gain 50 additional ATK, up to 2500.

sequences.name: Where Reality Meets Illusion, Where Living Meet Dead
sequences.descriptionEvidence: When a Resonator in the team gains a Shield, all Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s.

sequences.name: Ends Return to Beginnings, Truth of Life Laid Bare
sequences.descriptionEvidence: When Jingran takes a fatal blow, he will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 50% of Max HP for 15s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

sequences.name: As Favors and Feuds Fade, New Stories Await
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Jingran. The DMG Multiplier of Chimei Wangliang is increased by 80%. Upon entering the Yinghuo state, Jingran gains the Parade of Thousand Souls effect for 15s. During this effect, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, upon dealing damage, Jingran summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Chimei Wangliang can be summoned this way at an interval of 1s for up to 8 times. If Phrolova is in Maestro state when she casts this skill, Hecate additionally casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate 2 times when Phrolova is switched off the field while in the same Maestro state duration.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 1
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The DMG Multiplier of Movement of Fate and Finality is increased by 80%. The DMG Multiplier of Murmurs in a Haunting Dream is increased by 80%. If Phrolova has less than 2 Volatile Notes when she is not in the Maestro state and stays out of combat for 4s, she gains Volatile Note - Cadenza until she has at least 2 Volatile Notes.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 2
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The DMG Multiplier of Scarlet Coda is increased by 75%. Aftersound now additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of Scarlet Coda by 75%. Casting Scarlet Coda grants 14 stacks of Aftersound.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 3
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Echo Skill DMG is Amplified by 80%. Casting Scarlet Coda will convert all Volatile Notes to Volatile Notes - Cadenza in turn. Targets hit by Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza will have their ATK reduced by 20% for 15s.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 4
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Casting Echo Skill grants 20% Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 5
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Upon entering the Maestro state, generate a field to Stagnate the nearby targets, which lasts for 4s. Leaving the Maestro state or switching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect early. Damage taken during the Maestro state is reduced by 30%.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 6
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The DMG Multiplier of Enhanced Attack - Hecate is increased by 24%. During Movement of Fate and Finality and Murmurs in a Haunting Dream, command Hecate to cast 1 Apparition of Beyond - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 216.42% of Phrolova's ATK (considered Echo Skill DMG) and granting 8 stacks of Aftersound on hit. If Phrolova is not the active Resonator during the Maestro state, targets take 40% more DMG from Hecate and Phrolova. If Phrolova is the active Resonator during the Maestro state, gain 60% Havoc DMG Bonus.

Resonators with Edgerunner Bonds gain 1 stack of Overlimit every 0.2s, each stack granting 0.5% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification, up to 35% (Lucy automatically receives max stacks when her Edgerunner Bonds is active). inherentSkill1.descriptionEvidence: Casting Intro Skill - Solsworn Etymology grants Convergent for 20s. Convergent The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the same type and removes Convergent. When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority. When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop, Convergent doesn't take effect.

inherentSkill2.name: True Names Aligned
inherentSkill2.descriptionEvidence: When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains a stack of Blessing of Runes, up to 6 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. This effect resets upon a lineup change. Blessing of Runes Each stack of Blessing of Runes grants the active Resonator in the team 3% Aero DMG Bonus and 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus. When Blessing of Runes reaches 6 stacks. Sigrika gains an additional 30% increase in Aero DMG Bonus and Echo Skill DMG Bonus. For every 1% of Sigrika's Energy Regen over 125%, Sigrika gains 2% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for up to 50%.

outroSkill.name: In This Very Moment
outroSkill.descriptionEvidence: Attack the target, deal Aero DMG equal to 795% of Sigrika's ATK. Gain 2 stacks of Encapsulated for 30s. Encapsulated When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skills, Stagnate the target and consume 1 stacks of Encapsulated. Encapsulated stacks up to 2 times. All stacks of Encapsulated are removed when Sigrika is removed from the lineup.

forteCircuitTune.name: Tune Break
forteCircuitTune.descriptionEvidence: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 1
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Elucidated, Dodge Counter - Decipher, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, and Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid are increased by 70%. Sigrika becomes immune to interruptions while casting Basic Attack - Elucidated, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, and Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid. Encapsulated now stacks up to 3 times. After casting Outro Skill In This Very Moment, Sigrika obtains 1 additional stacks.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 2
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The DMG Multiplier of Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is increased by 120%. When not in combat for over 4s, Sigrika gains Divergent. This effect is active for up to 1 time every 4s.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 3
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Innate Gift? now stacks up to 4 times and is no longer removed after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field. All Innate Gift? stacks are removed every 30s that Sigrika stays out of combat.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 4
sequences.descriptionEvidence: When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Resonators in the team gain an 20% ATK increase for 20s.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 5
sequences.descriptionEvidence: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Where Trust Leads Me! is increased by 30%.

sequences.name: Sequence Node 6
sequences.descriptionEvidence: Targets take 30% more DMG from Sigrika. Innate Gift? gains following effects: Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 15% DMG Amplification, up to 60%. Each stack causes Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name to ignore 7.5% of the target's DEF when dealing damage, up to 30%.

basicAttack.name: Unraveled Spring
basicAttack.descriptionEvidence: Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Cloud Breath on hit. Mid-air Attack - Zephyr Stance Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG. Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Cloud Breath on hit. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Stage 4.

inherentSkill2.descriptionEvidence: Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices raises the Havoc Bane stacks on the targets to the maximum on hit.
